title: poa angustifolia f. glauca
intro: Poa angustifolia f. glauca, commonly known as Blue Fescue, is a subspecies of grass within the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Poa angustifolia f. glauca include soothing and calming effects, making it a possible remedy for stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
